currentCard.prompt: Какова основная физическая роль лёгочного сурфактанта в альвеолах?

answers.note: Сурфактант выделяют альвеолярные клетки II типа; он состоит из фосфолипидов и белков.
Клетки I типа образуют до 97% поверхности альвеол и хорошо пропускают газы.
Сурфактант состоит из фосфолипидов и белков; клетки II типа выделяют его для снижения натяжения альвеол.
Альвеолярная и капиллярная мембраны вместе образуют дыхательную мембрану толщиной около 0,5 мкм.

currentCard.explanation: Правильный ответ — снижать поверхностное натяжение. Сурфактант выделяют альвеолярные клетки II типа; это фосфолипидно-белковое вещество уменьшает натяжение в альвеолах.

source.title: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e: Organs and Structures of the Respiratory System

literal.prompt: Какова основная физическая роль лёгочного сурфактанта в альвеолах?

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: L97 explicitly says typeII cells secrete phospholipid/protein surfactant that REDUCES alveolar surface tension. L93 associates expanding alveoli with increased gas-exchange surface; L96 describes large thin gas-permeable typeI surface; L98–L99 describe a thin diffusion membrane. Therefore reducing area, raising tension and thickening membrane are not its stated main physical function. All four infinitive verb phrases are comparable proposed alveolar physical effects; exactly key0 matches the primary definition.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Правильный ответ — снижать поверхностное натяжение. Сурфактант выделяют альвеолярные клетки II типа; это фосфолипидно-белковое вещество уменьшает натяжение в альвеолах.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: First sentence directly names the true reducing-surface-tension answer. L97 supports the second sentence’s typeII source, phospholipid/protein composition and tension reduction. “Натяжение в альвеолах” refers back to the explicit surface-tension qualifier rather than changing to lung pressure or tissue stiffness. Two sentences meet the explanatory contract.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Сурфактант выделяют альвеолярные клетки II типа; он состоит из фосфолипидов и белков.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: L97 explicitly supplies both typeII alveolar secretion and phospholipid/protein composition. These are useful own-surfactant facts beyond its asked physical effect; note does not merely restate surface-tension reduction.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Клетки I типа образуют до 97% поверхности альвеол и хорошо пропускают газы.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: L96 states typeI cells constitute UP TO97 percent of alveolar surface and are highly gas-permeable. Note preserves the upper-bound qualifier and ties the wrong area-reduction claim to the actual specialised gas-exchange surface. L93 supplies surface increase with distension, so the useful fact concerns the offered quantity, not an arbitrary nearby organ.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Сурфактант состоит из фосфолипидов и белков; клетки II типа выделяют его для снижения натяжения альвеол.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: L97 identifies typeII source and composition and explicitly gives the actual direction—REDUCING tension. For this false increase claim, the note supplies the concrete corrected rule/direction and substance rather than an empty “wrong” label.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Альвеолярная и капиллярная мембраны вместе образуют дыхательную мембрану толщиной около 0,5 мкм.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: L98 says alveolar and capillary membranes together form a respiratory membrane approximately0.5μm thick; L99 describes gas diffusion. Note preserves approximate value, component combination and micrometre unit, making a concrete own-thickness fact for this distractor.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.prompt: Какова основная физическая роль лёгочного сурфактанта в альвеолах?
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.note: Сурфактант выделяют альвеолярные клетки II типа; он состоит из фосфолипидов и белков.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.grammar: Infinitive «Снижать» fits «основная физическая роль» as a function label and is grammatically parallel to all three alternatives; note has a clear secreting-cell subject.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.plausibility: Surface-tension change is a genuine physical property of alveoli; choosing its direction requires the surfactant definition or substantive mechanics, not grammar.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.truthUniqueKey: L97 directly gives lowering surface tension, so key0 is unique. Area loss and barrier thickening are not its stated principal function, and increasing tension reverses the direct source.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.noteTruthUsefulness: Own-option note adds who secretes surfactant and what it is composed of, both explicit atL97. TypeII cells and phospholipid/protein composition are absent from prompt/key and are concrete extra facts, even though explanation repeats them.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.note: Клетки I типа образуют до 97% поверхности альвеол и хорошо пропускают газы.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.plausibility: Surface area is a real determinant of alveolar exchange, making this a plausible confusion with the target’s effects on alveolar surfaces rather than a nonsensical anatomical object.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.truthUniqueKey: L97 defines surfactant’s principal effect as lowering tension; L93 instead links alveolar expansion with increased exchange surface. Reducing exchange area is not the requested main effect.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.noteTruthUsefulness: L96 supplies an actual own-area fact: typeI cells cover up to97% and permit gas passage. It is useful specifically to understanding gas-exchange surface and preserves “до”, not a claim of fixed97% or cell-number fraction.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.noteTruthUsefulness: The note corrects that specific reversed rule: the named substance, its typeII secretion and phospholipid/protein composition lead to tension reduction. fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.prompt: Какова основная физическая роль лёгочного сурфактанта в альвеолах?
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.note: Альвеолярная и капиллярная мембраны вместе образуют дыхательную мембрану толщиной около 0,5 мкм.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.grammar: Infinitive «Увеличивать» with object «толщину дыхательной мембраны» matches the other proposed physical-function labels.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.plausibility: Membrane thickness is another real structural parameter relevant to diffusion, so confusing surfactant film with thickening of the barrier is an intelligible alternative.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.truthUniqueKey: L97 names tension lowering, not barrier thickening. L98–L99 describe the thin0.5μm exchange barrier for diffusion; the source supplies no basis to make increased barrier thickness surfactant’s main physical role.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.noteTruthUsefulness: The note teaches the actual respiratory membrane’s two sides and approximate thickness atL98, the same quantity and object as the wrong claim. The approximate0.5μm is distinct from L96 typeI cell thickness25nm and is not a unit mix-up.

absoluteLevel.individualGround: The item requires specific alveolar-biophysics knowledge of pulmonary surfactant as a surface-tension-reducing material, rather than broad knowledge of organ or alveolus identity. A general adult or casual medicine reader need not know this physical mechanism. Alternatives use real surface/area/barrier variables; someone with diffusion or mechanics knowledge can rule out area loss/thickening and must still know or reason the tension direction. This satisfies specific-knowledge HARD without demanding an obscure clinical protocol or arbitrary numbers.

correctNoteExtraFact.fact: TypeII alveolar cells secrete surfactant, which consists of phospholipids and proteins.
correctNoteExtraFact.beyondPromptAndKey: Question/key ask its main physical effect only. Cellular source and composition are additional own-substance facts, explicitlyL97. Their overlap with explanation is allowed.
